content: Skelim gut ol pren bilong yu
Planti manmeri bai i tok olsem ol i pren bilong yu, tasol sampela i giaman tasol.
Sapos gutpela pren bilong yu i kamap birua bilong yu, bai yu bel hevi nogut tru.
O sori tumas. Watpo dispela kain pasin i kamap na i bagarapim olgeta ples?
Giaman pren i save stap wantaim yu long gutpela taim, tasol em bai i givim baksait long yu long taim bilong hevi.
Dispela giaman pren i save kaikai wantaim yu long taim bilong pati. Tasol long taim bilong pait, em i save hait i stap.
Sapos yu gat pren tru, orait yu mas tingim em oltaim. Na taim yu gat planti samting, yu no ken lusim tingting long em.
Glasim gut ol tingting ol manmeri i givim long yu
Planti manmeri i laik helpim yu long tingting bilong ol, tasol sampela i no tingim yu. Ol i tingim ol yet.
Lukaut gut long ol dispela kain manmeri. Painimaut pastaim, ol i gat wanem kain tingting. Ol i laik helpim yu, o nogat? Nogut ol i wok long daunim yu.
Nogut ol dispela manmeri i giamanim yu na i tok, “Wok bilong yu i orait.” Na ol i lukluk nating long yu long taim yu bagarap.
Yu no ken askim helpim long ol manmeri i no laik wok wantaim yu. Na yu no ken autim tingting bilong yu long ol manmeri i mangalim ol samting bilong yu.
Tru

Tasol oltaim yu mas wokabaut wantaim ol stretpela manmeri. Long wanem, yu save ol i manmeri bilong bihainim lo bilong God, na ol i wanbel wantaim yu, na ol i save wari long yu long taim yu laik pundaun.
Na tu, yu mas bihainim tingting bilong yu yet, long wanem, save bilong yu em i gutpela poroman bilong yu.
Sampela taim yu tasol inap skelim gut wanpela samting, na save bilong yu inap winim tru save bilong planti wasman.
Tasol nambawan samting tru, yu mas prea oltaim long Bikpela Antap, bai em i soim yu long rot i tru.
Glasim gut ol tingting bilong yu yet
Yu no ken kirapim wok nating. Yu mas tingting na toktok gut pastaim.
Tingting bilong ol manmeri i save kamapim 4-pela kain samting, em samting i gutpela na samting i nogut
na samting bilong dai na samting bilong laip. Na tang bilong man i save bosim ol dispela 4-pela samting.
Sampela manmeri i gat gutpela tingting na ol i save gut long skulim ol arapela, tasol ol i no inap long mekim gut wok bilong ol yet.
Sampela manmeri i save gut long toktok, tasol ol i bagarap long hangre. Na ol manmeri i no laik harim tok bilong ol.
Long wanem, ol dispela kain manmeri i no kisim save long Bikpela. Olsem na ol i no gat wanpela gutpela tingting i stap.
Sampela manmeri i gat save na ol i helpim ol yet, na ol i mekim ol gutpela toktok tasol.
Sampela manmeri i gat save na ol i helpim ol arapela. Na pasin bilong ol dispela kain manmeri tasol i save karim gutpela kaikai.
Ol manmeri bai i litimapim nem bilong ol manmeri i gat save. Na ol manmeri i lukim ol bai i tok olsem, “Yu win tru.”
Ol manmeri i no save stap oltaim.
Tasol ol manmeri i bilipim tok bilong man i gat save, na nem bilong em bai i stap oltaim.
Yu no ken kaikai planti tumas
Pikinini, yu mas was gut long ol pasin bilong yu. Na lukluk gut. Yu no ken kisim ol samting inap long bagarapim yu.
Laik bilong ol wan wan manmeri i no wankain. Olsem na olgeta wan wan samting i no orait long ol wan wan man na meri.
Yu no ken mangalim ol switpela kaikai tasol, na yu no ken kaikai planti tumas,
long wanem, sapos yu kaikai planti yu bai pilim sik, na sapos yu pulapim tru bel bilong yu, bai yu traut.
Planti manmeri i bin i dai, long wanem, ol i kaikai planti tumas. Tasol ol manmeri i was gut na i no kaikai planti, ol bai i stap longpela taim.
